verdict.rationale: React is an open-source (MIT-licensed) client/server library distributed via npm and GitHub, so by nature it runs entirely on infrastructure the developer controls with no vendor-hosted service to depend on — evidence shows the source is fully public and openly licensed (react-gh-1, react-comm-4) and can be used standalone or via SSR/streaming on any server (react-docs-6, react-gh-2). Missing for 10: no explicit first-party documentation framing this as 'self-hosting', and no discussion of any hosted/SaaS alternative it replaces.
